newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-DECEMBER RETURN FOR TOMBA.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-DECEMBER RETURN FOR TOMBA.

text.p: Alberto Tomba should be back on skis next month, his doctor said on Monday.
Maurilio Marcacci said he had given the go-ahead for the Olympic and world champion, injured during training oacier last month, to work out in the gym to speed his recovery.
"I think that at the beginning of December he should be already out on the pistes," he said.
Tomba said after hospital tests in his home town of Bologna: "These things take time, one must have patience."

The Italian has yet to set a date for his first race of the season but has been widely expected to return in the Italian resort of Madonna di Campiglio on December 17 -- two days before his 30th birthday.
